verdict.rationale: Perplexity Computer documents a direct bulk capability: running browser tasks across dozens of URLs in parallel and collecting the results into structured output. It also processes CSV, JSON and Excel data in a sandboxed VM. The bulk claim is a single line, scoped to browser tasks at 'dozens' scale, with no hands-on confirmation. missing for 10: bulk actions across connected services (e.g. batch updates to Jira/Linear/Gmail items), documented limits and behavior for large batches, independent or hands-on corroboration of parallel execution.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Run browser tasks across dozens of URLs in parallel, collecting results into structured output.
Process CSV, JSON, Excel, PDF, images, audio, and video files.
